answer_verbatim:
If your goal is simply to **check whether ChatGPT and similar AI engines recommend your small business**, the best starting point is a **free baseline tool** like **HubSpot’s AI Search Grader / AEO Grader** because it is explicitly described as a free one-time diagnostic covering ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.[2][15]

If you want the **best small-business option overall** for ongoing tracking and actionable fixes, the results most strongly point to **Surfeo**, **Guzu AI**, or **Otterly.AI** depending on your budget and whether you want a dashboard or a one-time report.[8][7][11] Surfeo is described as a strong all-in-one SMB option with free first audit plus paid plans, while Guzu AI emphasizes a free GEO audit with an instant ChatGPT check and action plan, and Otterly.AI is positioned as a lower-cost monitoring choice.[8][7][11]

A practical way to choose is:

- **Free one-time check:** **HubSpot AI Search Grader / AEO Grader**.[2][15]
- **Best value for small-business ongoing tracking:** **Otterly.AI** or **Rankscale**.[11][14]
- **Best “tell me what to fix” option:** **Surfeo** or **Guzu AI**.[8][7]
- **Best if you already use Semrush:** **Semrush AI Visibility**.[2][19]

If you want the shortest recommendation: **start with HubSpot for a free check, then move to Surfeo or Otterly.AI if you want ongoing monitoring**.[2][8][11]
